name: devmeet
description: DevMeet — Dating & Networking for Developers (MERN Fullstack Platform)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"

author: Mohd Zaid
